text: In December 2021, the Infrastructure and Environment Committee directed the General Manager, Parks, Forestry and Recreation to report back to the April 26, 2022 meeting of the Infrastructure and Environment Committee with an update regarding increased public access to the washroom facilities at the Guild Park and Gardens. This report will provide an overview of work completed to the washroom facilities at Guild Park and Gardens.
The Infrastructure and Environment Committee received the report (April 5, 2022) from the General Manager, Parks, Forestry and Recreation for information.
